Step-by-Step Guide on How to 
Process New Business Applications:
1. Secure client’s information using our team’s form or directly from the client.
2. Prepare client’s application forms using your preferred mode of submission.

SunSMART+ (iPAD)
SunSMART+ (web version)
Paper Application
ACCESS GUIDES HERE
3. Guide the client on how to sign and pay for the policy.
ACCESS CLIENT DIGITAL APPLICATION GUIDE HERE
ACCESS PAYMENT GUIDES HERE

NOTE: For F2F Meetings you may assist client 
in signing on ipad/mousepad/mobile screen
NOTE: Client may also use PAY NOW function in SunSMART & SunSMART+
4. Update the client about Temporary Life Insurance (if applicable) and progress of application.
5. Wait for SETTLEMENT notification (1-3 days if clean case) or additional requirements from UW.
Step-by-Step Guide on How to Request for LOA:

NOTE: If Underwriter required client to undergo MEDICAL EXAM AND/OR MEDICAL TESTS (e.g. Liver Function Test, Urinalysis, etc) you may request for LOA as long as test is included in the following list and underwriting team didn’t specify it as AT NO COST TO SUN LIFE.
1. Check laboratory test you can request here:
2. Confirm with client what day is convenient for him/her (LOA is only valid for 14 DAYS).
3. Check ACCREDITED MEDICAL FACILITY nearest to client through LOA Request form in STEP 4.
4. Fill-out LOA REQUEST FORM through this link:
ACCESS LOA REQUEST FORM HERE
5. You will receive the LOA form via email, if none, follow up at Phil_NB@sunlife.com.
6. Send LOA to client. Remind them to bring ONE VALID GOVERNMENT-ISSUED ID (with birthdate and signature and printed LOA).
NOTE: Best to also call medical facility one day before client’s schedule to confirm availability especially for MEDEX.

POLICY
SERVICING

Step-by-Step Guide on What to 
Do After Client’s Policy is Settled:
1. Inform and congratulate the client. You can send an art card or simply screenshot of the settlement sms from Sun Life.
2. Inform client to use POLICY NUMBER in future payments (PIN IN MESSSENGER for easier access for both of you). Inform not to use the application serial number for future payments (SER).
3. Inform when is the next due date.
4. Guide client on how to activate their client portal (click CLIENT PORTAL above).
5. Inform client once POLICY CONTRACT is available (click POLICY DELIVERY above).
How to Activate Client Portal
1. Send this STEP-BY-STEP Guide to client:
DOWNLOAD HERE
2. Once activated already, guide them to download the mobile application:
Step-by-Step Guide for Policy Delivery:
NOTE: Best to opt for ELECTRONIC POLICY CONTRACT (default if application is via SunSMART+. For Paper App should be specified in REMARKS at ADVISOR’S REPORT.
FOR ELECTRONIC POLICY CONTRACT:

-Automatically delivered to client few days after settlement via EMAIL.
-Inform the client and conduct policy review.
FOR HARD COPY/PAPER POLICY CONTRACT:

-It will be delivered to DURIAN NBO or ISO
-You should deliver it to client personally (courier delivery is not allowed anymore)
-You must submit signed PAR (Policy Acknowledgement Receipt)
-Send signed, complete and clear copy of the PAR form in PDF FORMAT at: Phil_Scanning@sunlife.com
  (File Name:  PAR <policy number> example PAR 081234567)
  (Email Subject: PAR Submission for P/N <policy number>)
DOWNLOAD POLICY DELIVERY GUIDELINES HERE
Payment Tracking

NOTE: It’s your duty as an Advisor to check if client is paying his/her policy on time. Sun Life sends SMS and email reminder to client but make sure to also follow-up client if you notice delays in payment. You can check payment summary on ADVISOR HOME OFFICE but you may also use this excel file to have a summary of payments made by the client that you can also send to them.
DOWNLOAD SAMPLE EXCEL FILE FOR PAYMENT TRACKING HERE

NOTE: 
Use the excel with file name: 0YEAR CLIENTS to have a summary of client’s payment PER YEAR (one worksheet for each client), make one workbook as well for your ORPHAN CLIENTS.
Use the excel file with file name: CLIENTS MASTERLIST to have a summary of all your clients for all years in one workbook. Make worksheets for clients who will have due dates on certain month in this excel file too.
Client Policy Anniversary

NOTE: Always greet your clients every policy anniversary. You can send an art card that contains policy benefits summary and policy updates (cash value, fund value, dividends, etc.) You can also use this to offer policy review with them. This could be a way for you to RESELL.
ACCESS SAMPLE ART CARD HERE
How to Process Servicing Requests via AHO
1. Log in to Advisor Home Office
2. Click three horizonal lines
3. Click CLIENTS
4. Click Servicing Requests
5. Type client’s name and click name
6. Select a service request
7. Click policy to service and upload requirements.

CLICK HERE FOR SERVICING FAQS AND LIST OF 
REQUIREMENTS PER SERVICING TYPE
8. Click PROCEED. Check I have read and agree to Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.
9. Click I AGREE. Click SUBMIT.
10. You and client will received notification (via SMS and email) once submitted and also if it is APPROVED/DENIED/RETURNED.

Step-by-Step Guide on How to 
Open Your BPI Payroll Account:
1. Choose preferred BPI Branch (EXCEPT BPI Family)
2. Fill-out the BPI Introduction Letter with the required information (under NBO/Sales Team put: DURIAN). Don’t leave any details blank. Put exact BPI branch location/address.
DOWNLOAD BLANK FORM HERE
3. Use your digital signature to sign the form.
4. Send via e-mail the accomplished form in PDF file format to:

#Phil-AgencyLicensing@sunlife.com
SUBJECT: BPI/DURIAN/Surname, First Name
5. Go to the branch specified three (3) working days after sending the form. Bring Valid gov’t ID.
6. Send via e-mail your proof of account (Validated Deposit Slip or Screenshot of Mobile Bank Account Showing your Name and Account Number OR Validated Introduction Letter Return Slip) to:

#Phil-AgencyLicensing@sunlife.com
SUBJECT: DURIAN/BPI Account/Surname, First Name

NOTE: We can’t renew our license every 3 years if we don’t register our Sun Life business in BIR. Best if you would get a BOOKEEPER to do this for you to avoid hassle. You must do this BEFORE FIRST COMMISSION CREDITING or WITHIN 3 MONTHS FROM CODING.

For Warm Prospects (FB Friends, Relatives etc.)

NOTE: EDIT FIRST GOOGLE FORM

Hi! Good day! I am reaching out to know if you are interested to start your income protection plan with investment or health protection plan with savings before your birthday? You can avail big discount if you decide to take action before your birthday as premium increases as we age.

If ever you are still unsure but interested to inquire, you may fill out this form: https://bit.ly/StartYourFinancialPlan 

Thank you and advance happy birthday!
For Warm Prospects & Cold Prospects
NOTE: MAKE CALENDLY ACCOUNT AND CONNECT WITH YOUR SUN LIFE GOOGLE CALENDAR. THIS WILL ALSO HELP YOU SO THAT MEETING BOOKINGS WILL BE DIRECTED TO YOUR GOOGLE CALENDAR.

Hi! I'm ____. 

I help individuals start their financial plan. You might be interested to start one for yourself too or baka may kakilala ka rin na naghahanap where to invest for future plans, wants to be financially protected in case of SAD (Sickness, Accident, Disability) events and get income benefit in case of hospitalization, please do let me know so I can reach out and help them achieve their current or future financial goals. 

I would really appreciate your kind referral and together let's spread financial literacy to your relatives and friends.  

We can do it remotely via online meeting platforms. They can book a meeting with me via this link: https://bit.ly/StartYourFinancialPlanWithKristalyn

Thank you and God Bless!
